description: This script appears to be a test script for the Git version control system, specifically testing the 'skip-worktree' bit feature. It sets up a repository state, modifies the index to add or remove skip-worktree flags on files, and verifies the behavior with various commands and expectations.

methods.name: test_set_index_version
methods.description: Sets the GIT_INDEX_VERSION environment variable to the specified value, controlling the version of the index used.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that should succeed, executing the provided commands and verifying their success.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the output of commands to expected outputs stored in files.
